record.title: Microduck neck plate — 'neck' in Pollen's MJCF: 2 x 20 x 11 mm plate, R2 corners, 4 x Ø2.3, one of the two plates spanning the 50 mm neck between the neck-pitch and head-pitch XL330s
record.why: cad/part.py builds one valid solid and ce-cad/bin/cad-refcheck grades it against Pollen's own published mesh reference/pollen-microduck-rl/assets/neck.stl: p95 surface distance 0.001 mm ref->ours / 0.001 mm ours->ref, bbox delta 0.00 mm per axis, 5/5 reference holes and bosses matched, 0 unmatched (out/refcheck/microduck-neck-plate/r1, evidence/refcheck/2026-09-01T19-35-29Z).
record.origin_why: modelled by hand in cecad from measurements taken off Pollen Robotics' decimated visual mesh (CC BY-SA-NC sim asset) with cecad.meshslice interval probes and cecad.meshfeatures; nobody has Pollen's CAD and no physical part has been measured. Admitted through the TRIAD.md door: evidence/ledger.jsonl + computed trust.json.
record.source_reference: reference/pollen-microduck-rl/assets/neck.stl (Pollen microduck RL assets, exported by onshape-to-robot)
record.why_this_folder_exists: The Microduck's neck link is two of this one plate — the MJCF places the SAME neck.stl twice in the `neck` body (pos (22,50,28) and (22,50,3) mm, same quat), 25 mm apart, bolted M2 to the neck-pitch servo case below and the head-pitch servo case above. Nothing on the shelf is a 2 mm XL330-to-XL330 case strap.
